categories.main_business_segments: Tianli International Holdings Limited is a leading comprehensive education service operator in the PRC, primarily providing comprehensive education management and diversified services including high school education, educational consulting, management services, and logistical support. The Group operates a network of 58 schools across 36 cities, focusing on high school education and related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group emphasizes a proprietary educational philosophy called 'Six Establishments and One Accomplishment,' focusing on academic excellence and holistic student development. It integrates AI education technology through self-developed AI products such as the 'Qiming AI Companion' large model, AI Bootcamp, AI Intelligent Study Hub, and AI Classrooms to enhance teaching efficiency and personalized learning. The Group also employs a centralized and standardized management system to ensure quality and operational efficiency across its schools.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are high school students and their parents in the PRC, with approximately 60,000 high school students enrolled as of 2025. The Group also serves local governments through cooperation agreements and provides management and franchise services to entrusted schools. The education services cater to students preparing for national and international university admissions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group has a strong presence in Sichuan Province and operates schools across 36 cities in 18 provinces and regions in China, including Inner Mongolia, Shandong, Henan, Hebei, Guizhou, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Yunnan, Gansu, Anhui, Guangxi, Guangdong, Shaanxi, Shanghai, Chongqing, and Hubei.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tianli International Holdings operates primarily downstream in the education service supply chain, directly providing educational services, management, and logistical support to students and schools. It also engages in product sales related to student necessities and educational materials, supported by an enhanced supply chain channel layout within its school network.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group's strategic focus is dual-driven by expanding its fundamental education business and advancing AI education technology. It aims to grow its school network, improve teaching quality, and diversify education services while leveraging AI to reduce labor costs, improve teaching efficiency, and commercialize AI education products through B2B, B2G, and community-based models. The Group also pursues overseas expansion and cooperation with international educational institutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through comprehensive educational service fees, sales of products (such as student necessities and agricultural products), comprehensive logistical services (including canteen and daily life support), and management and franchise fees from entrusted schools. Fees are typically received in advance and recognized over the service period.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group positions itself as a leading comprehensive private education service operator in the PRC with a strong brand and extensive school network. It competes in a highly competitive education sector, focusing on quality teaching, diversified services, and AI technology integration to maintain competitive advantages. Specific competitors are not named in the report.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 31 August 2025, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB3.59 billion, representing an 8.1% increase from the previous year, and a profit for the year of RMB648.1 million, up 16.5%. The Group has shown steady growth in student enrollment and financial performance since its listing in 2018, with total assets nearing RMB10 billion and net assets of approximately RMB3 billion as of 2025.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group emphasizes high-quality education with a holistic approach to student development, combining strong academic performance with creativity, communication skills, and social responsibility. Its unique value lies in its proprietary educational philosophy, extensive school network, consistent high admission rates to top-tier universities, and innovative integration of AI technology to enhance teaching and operational efficiency. The Group also focuses on comprehensive campus safety, teacher development, and sustainable ESG practices to differentiate itself.
